INFERRED. The only objective of «Primeriza» (107), «Hacer que nazca 1 montura»: the client lists it without a criterion, so the achievement could never be earned. Its siblings say how births are counted: «Hacer que nazcan 10 monturas» (106) is (EB>0,9), 100 (108) is (EB>0,99) and 1000 (109) is (EB>0,999), each key 0 any colour, which the breeding counts as each litter is born (BreedingHandler, EB 0 with the children). «Naissance d'une vocation» (1467) asks for it before Ademaga will hear how a mount gives birth.

eachCharacter.measured: «Primer tiempo», whose experience makes the character level 2. The client's step of 2502 for objective 19250 («Consigue las recompensas del logro y reparte los puntos de característica», tutorial step 15) waits for level 2, the characteristics sheet opened, points spent and the sheet closed, and only then validates it (idw 19250, as the capture does after mga, mfs and kum). A second character of an account that already had it stayed at level 1 with no points, and the tutorial could not go on.
